name: range_derivWithin_subset_closure_span_image
statement: 𝕜 → F) {s t : Set 𝕜} (h : s ⊆ closure (s ∩ t)) : range (derivWithin f s) ⊆ closure (Submodule.span 𝕜 (f '' t))

name: HasDerivWithinAt.nonneg_of_monotoneOn
statement: AccPt x (𝓟 s)) (hd : HasDerivWithinAt g g' s x) (hg : MonotoneOn g s) : 0 ≤ g'

name: HasDerivWithinAt.nonpos_of_antitoneOn

have_tree.body: fun x hx y hy hxy ↦ by simpa using hg hx hy hxy

name: HasDerivWithinAt.limsup_norm_slope_le
statement: HasDerivWithinAt f f' s x) (hr : ‖f'‖ < r) : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝[s] x, ‖z - x‖⁻¹ * ‖f z - f x‖ < r

name: HasDerivWithinAt.liminf_right_slope_norm_le
